card.name: Question words opening a new sentence
card.fires_on: Capitalized question words (Where, What, How, Why) that begin a new sentence or heading in general web prose, often after a period or line break.

modes.label: Sentence-opening wh-word
modes.description: A capitalized wh-word starts a sentence right after the previous sentence ends, as a question or an opening clause.
modes.example: “I was totally amazed.<< What>> ran through my mind was that this looked

modes.label: Heading or list question
modes.description: A wh-word or How starts a headline, list item or rhetorical question after a break.
modes.example: Connect with Nature <<What>> better way to celebrate Earth Day 2

card.plain: It fires on words like What, How and Why when they start a new sentence, usually a question.
